title: Python ML: Cross Validation
description: Cross Validation is a technique for evaluating a machine learning model and testing its performance. It is a more robust method than a simple train/test split. In K-Fold Cross Validation, the data is divided into 'k' subsets. The model is trained on k-1 subsets and tested on the remaining one, repeating this process k times.
example:
// K-Fold Cross Validation with Scikit-learn
from sklearn import datasets
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, cross_val_score

X, y = datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)
clf = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42)

k_folds = KFold(n_splits = 5)
scores = cross_val_score(clf, X, y, cv = k_folds)

print("Cross Validation Scores: ", scores)
print("Average Score: ", scores.mean())
